name: ST NUCLEO-WB55RG (Nucleo-64)
description: Easiest way into STM32WB: Bluetooth 5 LE and 802.15.4 (Zigbee/Thread) dual-core Cortex-M4/M0+ on a Nucleo-64 with USB FS, PCB antenna, ST-LINK and Arduino headers.
notes: The wireless stack runs on the Cortex-M0+ radio core and must be loaded once as a binary through the FUS using STM32CubeProgrammer.
Has a second USB connector for the MCU's USB FS device port in addition to the ST-LINK port. Also sold with a USB dongle as P-NUCLEO-WB55.
ST eStore price was far above the original launch price in late 2026 (Arrow showed about $34); compare distributors.
